nextPageToken.description: The next pagination token or an empty value if no more results.

Subproject.description: Subprojects are used to logically group a set of product services.

createTime.description: The date/time the subproject was created. ISO 8601 format.

deleted.description: The current deleted state of the subproject.

displayName.description: The display name of the subproject. You cannot have a null value. It does not have to be unique.

additionalProperties.description: A map of labels. String, key-value pairs that are completely customizable to allow for your metadata. Both the key and the value can be modified. Example: `"region": "US-Northwest"`

parentProjectId.description: The parent project ID the subproject belongs to. Set from the URL path on creation; a value sent in the request body is ignored.

subprojectId.description: The unique subproject identifier. Not to be confused with the `parentProjectId`; the `subprojectId` is a new ID related to your parent project.

updateTime.description: The date/time the subproject was updated. ISO 8601 format.
